Select drug-indication relationships with molecule identifiers, names, MeSH identifiers, EFO identifiers, indication labels, and max phase for indication. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Return chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
